notes: Level 1 is the dots to connect: six of them, one per act, each a sentence that could be true or false. A dot is not a beat and is never spoken. Its job is to be the thing every thread beneath it has to serve, and the thing the level-1 reviewer checks the threads against. Only thread T2-sugar-unlock is built out — see docs/curation/narration-architecture.md for why one thread and not sixty-three beats.

dots.dot: Every alcoholic drink is the same molecule in water, so the whole subject is production rather than substance.
Where the raw material already offers free sugar, a drink can happen with almost no invented technology.
Where the sugar is locked in starch, someone had to invent a conversion step, and that step is behind most of the world's drinking.
One machine put every drink above the fermentation ceiling, and it was applied to everything already met.
Some categories are not a fermentation at all but an addition made to one.
A large part of the taxonomy the listener now holds is statute rather than chemistry.
